about: HIS PAGE'S ROUTES (the rebuild, 2026-10-21): every address his host (web/app.py) answers, by name, and the LARRY LLM console pages a step's VIEW FULL PAGE opens. app.py registers each route from here.
routes_about: home: his page (GET); press: the security scan's switch (POST); voice: the standup spoken (queue, wav); voice_queue: the one POST a page of another origin may make; card: his picture; stream: his logs live (Server-Sent Events); core_css and theme: the look's files, read where they are. page_css: his page's own sheet (app/static/css/scrum_master.css), linked once in the page's head. rain_js: the code rain of his card, wid's own script, read where it is. building: every pending request's builder this moment (the owner 2026-10-24), asked by the page every 15 s. row_rules: one row's rules, what makes it red or green, fetched only when its panel is opened (the owner 2026-10-23).
full_pages_about: VIEW FULL PAGE (the owner 2026-10-13: "items like 9 · MOIRÉ ... that have a full page.. have a link that says view full page to go directly there"; "do that for all that have a full page"): a step's name -> the console page that is its whole tool; drawn only where that page opens for the viewer
